pcvs.name: newnets
pcvs.expression: DR nets whose owner has no gc net yet (addNet is called)

pcvs.name: kinds
pcvs.expression: sum over DR nets of the shape kinds (route/fixed polygons, route/fixed cut rectangles) the net receives in the region and did not hold before

pcvs.name: figs
pcvs.expression: connected figures of the DR nets (ext + route: path segments, vias, patch wires)

factors.criterion: a per-new-net term: constructing a gc net builds seven per-layer containers of numLayers elements whatever the net holds
per-figure/per-shape term separate from the per-net term; nets the design already created do not pay construction
first shape of a kind on a net (first insertion into an empty per-layer container) as a term

fix.effect: newnets coefficient falls from 1,627 to 439 (-73%); kinds rises from 403 to 680 (sizing a kind moves to its first add)

drperf.units: instructions per region call; [formula, unexplained percent]; small_formula_at_large in percent of the measured large total

grading: Semantic review against the record and code, not keyword matching. Equivalent expressions and well-supported alternative decompositions count. Coefficients are measured on this build and machine and are not acceptance thresholds.
scope: The case's scenario at the listed sizes on the standalone extraction; not an all-input guarantee and not a claim about OpenROAD's full router.
